observations.body: but God led the people around by the way of the wilderness by the Red Sea; and the children of Israel went up armed out of the land of Egypt.
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: God leads Israel by the wilderness road toward the Red Sea.
observations.label: A road not taken

observations.body: The wilderness is a chosen route that avoids early war and keeps Israel under visible guidance.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Exodus 13:16–22 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: The safer route is also longer, and the people do not yet know what its needs will expose.
payload.title: A route around the Philistine road
